mechanism: Full read: derives Ev=(P*RRR)-(1-P)*1, minimum win-rate P>1/(1+RRR) and minimum RRR>(1-P)/P tables, then Monte Carlo equity paths from fixed win-rate/RRR/position-size draws (1000 sims × 1000 trades) to score mean/median equity, ruin, and % profitable. No market-state, volatility, liquidity, or sequence sensor of the price series is built—only synthetic trade-outcome evaluation of a strategy edge.

mechanism: Treat ATR, standard-deviation, and Bollinger Band trailing stops as volatility sensors that dynamically move SL: high vol (e.g. 1000 pts) keeps trades open → higher realized RRR; low vol (e.g. 200 pts) cuts early → lower RRR. The fluctuating RRR induces a 'random win-rate' mix whose cumulative expectancy can still be positive if weighted toward positive-Ev RRR buckets.

mechanism: Monte Carlo mixes five random (win-rate, RRR) exit profiles over 100 trades × 500 runs; sum per-profile expectancy E=P*RRR-(1-P); cull negative-Ev exit modes and overweight positive-Ev modes. Senses which exit-regime mixture the live book is in by tracking realized (P,RRR) buckets and their equity/DD boxplots.

mechanism: Slow pivot = min/max high-low over slowPeriod (default 10); fast pivot over fastPeriod (5). Slow/fast line flips to period-low if close > prior line else period-high. Trend state: close below both lines → down (1); close above both → up (0). Color-split slow up/down plots and dotted fast color-line encode the regime.

quote: It consists of three main lines: a slow line acting as the primary trend reference (up or down based on price position), a fast dotted line that changes color on trend flips, and arrows marking the start of new trends when price crosses both lines.

mechanism: On bar where trendBuffer differs from prior bar, place color arrow at slowLine value (DRAW_COLOR_ARROW). Flip fires only when close crosses both fast and slow pivots, marking regime-change start rather than every pullback. Optional canvas gradient fill between slow and fast (opaque at slow → transparent at fast) visualizes regime strength.

mechanism: Two WaveTrend stacks on HLC/3 source: signal (channel=5, avg=10, ma=4) and trend (channel=10, avg=100, ma=10). Each builds ESA=EMA(src), D=EMA(|src-ESA|), CI=(src-ESA)/(0.015*D), WT1=EMA(CI,avg), WT2=SMA(WT1,ma). trend_is_bull/bear = WT1≷WT2 on the slow stack; optional use_trend_filter gates entries to matching trend. Candles recolored teal/red by trend_is_bull.
data_needed: high/low/close; CalcEMA; separate signal/trend length inputs; trend_is_bull/bear buffers
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart window any symbol/period; defaults as above

quote: By using dual WaveTrend configurations—one with shorter periods for sensitive signal generation and another with longer periods for overall trend detection—we can combine quick entry cues with broader market context.

mechanism: signal_bull_cross when WT1 crosses above WT2; signal_bear_cross when WT1 crosses below WT2. Buy arrow under low (offset base_offset*_Point) only if bull cross and (!use_trend_filter || trend_is_bull); sell arrow above high symmetrically. Marks momentum-regime transitions with optional slow-trend confirmation.

mechanism: On each tick, volumeDiff = tick_volume − lastTickVolume; attribute to ask (up) if close rose, bid (down) if fell, else carry lastTradeAtAsk. QuantizePriceToLevel snaps close to ticksPerPriceLevel*_Point grid; UpdatePriceLevel accumulates up/down volume into FootprintPriceLevel rows per bar (maxBarsToRender). Canvas overlays per-level volume text in DELTA or BID_VS_ASK mode.

mechanism: Per level delta = upVolume − downVolume; color by |delta|/maxDeltaValue tiers. Right column total = up+down colored by total/maxTotalVolumeValue. Highest-total-volume row inside a bar is that bar's point of control—revisits treated as liquidity reference. Delta divergence (price high, weakening delta) flagged narratively as fading aggression.

instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same footprint chart; DELTA display mode default

quote: High total volume rows inside a bar often mark the point of control for that bar — price tends to return to these levels on retracements.

mechanism: In BID_VS_ASK mode, for adjacent levels j and j+1: if ask_j / maxAsk ≥ 0.3, color ask by GetDiagonalVolumeColor(true, ask_j/(bid_{j+1}+ε)) with tiers at ratios 1.5/2/3/4; symmetrically for dominant bid below. Stacked diagonal imbalances mark directional liquidity pressure zones.
data_needed: Adjacent FootprintPriceLevel up/down volumes; maxAskValue/maxBidValue; 0.3 significance gate
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Footprint BID_VS_ASK mode; any chart symbol/period
